notes: Foundry request/response and trace evidence is not retroactive when logging was disabled or data expired.
Organization usage endpoints are aggregate telemetry, not a provider request-by-request audit feed.
Zero Data Retention or Modified Abuse Monitoring may reduce provider-retained content; application-side provenance becomes more important.
Compliance API Activity Feed has its own permissions and pagination; content retrieval may require a Compliance Access Key.
Model invocation logging is disabled by default.
Some Bedrock runtime and agent operations are CloudTrail data events and require explicit event selectors.
Data Access audit logging and retention are configuration dependent.
Ordinary enterprise audit logs do not include all local client prompt/session data; client OTel or custom hooks are separate sources.
Provider-native enterprise audit coverage varies; local and gateway evidence may be required.
